title: Jesus' Brothers and the Feast of Tabernacles
description: The Feast of Tabernacles was approaching, and Jesus' brothers wanted him to go up to Judea and show himself openly to the world, for they did not believe in him. Jesus answered: "My time has not yet come, but for you it is always the right time. The world cannot hate you, but it hates me because I testify that its deeds are evil." His brothers went up to the feast, but Jesus remained in Galilee.
